bind_address.description: Network interface IP address to bind the relay server to (e.g., 0.0.0.0 for all interfaces).

port.description: TCP port for the transit relay server.

max_connections_per_client.description: Maximum number of concurrent connections allowed per client IP.

max_total_connections.description: Maximum total concurrent connections across all clients. Set to 0 for unlimited.

rate_limit_bytes_per_sec.description: Global per-connection rate limit in bytes/second. Set to 0 for unlimited.

tls_enabled.description: Enable TLS encryption for connections to the relay server.

tls_cert_path.description: Path to the TLS certificate file (required if TLS is enabled).

tls_key_path.description: Path to the TLS private key file (required if TLS is enabled).

relay_hostname.description: Publicly accessible hostname for the relay (e.g., 'wormhole-relay.example.com'). If empty, inferred from bind_address/port.

rate_limit_namespaces.description: List of per-namespace (e.g., per-tenant or per-app) rate limits.

rate_limit_bytes_per_sec.description: Rate limit (bytes/sec) for connections in this namespace. 0 = no limit.
